name: short-dated defined-risk vertical credit spread
vol_filter: only enter when implied vol >= 1.2x trailing 21-session realized vol
entry: Sell the 0.15-delta strike (+/-0.08) in the nearest expiry 1-7 DTE; buy the strike $5 further OTM.
exit: take profit at 50% of credit; stop at 2.0x credit; else hold to expiry.
sizing: contracts sized so defined max loss <= 2.0% of equity
